messages.text: Mijo, domingo despues de misa trae pan de Vicky si puedes. Yo hago el sofrito temprano.
Claro. Pan, croquetas too?
Si, pocas. And I found that old Celia CD in the kitchen drawer, the one your tia always asked for.
Put it on while you cook and I will bring the good bag from the bakery.
Mijo, cuando llames despues de la cena dime si esta carta del seguro es la misma que viste el domingo.
Si, mandame foto antes de las 8:30. I can check it while we talk.
Tambien Marisol pregunto si vas a buscar pan para los ninos este weekend.
Tell her yes. I'll call you in a bit and Sunday I'll bring Cuban bread.
Bro, for the salsa potluck they want the little bio card. You writing yours in English or the way your mom will actually read it?
Probably both. If Lourdes sees only English she’ll tell me I got too fancy after school.
Put the Miami 11/14 line too. Birthday twins list is getting ridiculous.
Yeah, I’ll keep it short. Miami, 11/14, parents’ island jokes, done.
You watching that county forum or the Heat pregame? Pick one bro lol
Forum on laptop, game muted. I want to hear who gives real answers on clinic bills, hourly pay, and paperwork for families.
Still no team jersey for you huh
No jersey. Also no magic speeches. If it sounds like everything gets fixed by one huge plan, Mami's voice starts in my head.
Panther before the 7 pm opening in Wynwood? I saved us the window two-top if you bring the black pencils.
Yes. I need ten minutes at home first; the canvas by the window is still wet and my Mac is open right next to it.
Put a cup over the brushes before you leave. Last time your sleeve almost became part of the piece.
Done. Graphite roll is in my bag and I will meet you there by 6:05.
That cafecito sketch you posted from Calle Ocho got nice comments. The counter shadows looked so good.
Thanks. I almost deleted it because the pastelito looked like a brick, but the colors worked.
Leave it up. Also, if the 4th quarter gets wild tonight, your phone is going to end up on story again, I already know.
Only if Bam gives me a reason. Manny said he is putting the game on after dinner.
Mijo, en las noticias otra vez esa familia llorando. No entiendo por que nadie ensena el video completo.
Lo vi. Antes de que todos griten, quiero ver el reporte, quien revisa eso, and what happens after.
Si, porque esa mama merece una respuesta clara. Dios la ayude.
Exactly. Clear answer, no cover-up, and talk to people like they matter.
Mijo, el domingo pasamos por la iglesia temprano? Quiero dejar las flores de mami antes del almuerzo.
Si, I can pick you up at 9:15. I also found that old Celia record she used to play when she cleaned.
Ay, ponlo cuando prendas la velita. A ella le gustaba esa cancion.
I will. I may bring the little blue beads from the top drawer too, if you still want them there.
Downtown class still 7? I might grab cafecito first.
Class yes. I'm switching to tea from here on out today. Already had enough rocket fuel.
jajaja fair. Walk it off before you sit at the laptop again.
Doing one block now, no earbuds. Ten minutes before the next call.
Bro you still coming Thursday? You sounded cooked after work yesterday.
Bro you still coming Thursday? Downtown parking was full of blue lights last week lol
Yeah. End of month numbers got my chest tight and my brain doing laps, but salsa usually resets me.
Yeah, I'll leave early. Those lights still make me think of old speeding tickets and that Okeechobee Road crash paperwork.
Leave the laptop closed after 6:30. No extra cafecito either lol.
At least that night someone handled the scene right. You were way calmer after they moved everybody off the lane.
For real. I just keep my registration current now and drive boring.
Fair. I am sticking to the breathing timer and walking around the block before class.
Mami saw that video on the news again and keeps asking what actually happened. Can you call her tomorrow and explain it calmly?
Yeah. I already saved two solid write-ups instead of the loud stuff. I can send her one in Spanish too.
Good. And don't let Manny drag you to that packed downtown thing if your shoulders are already up to your ears.
I'm staying home for that part. I'll help in quieter ways and talk to Mami after dinner.
Mijo, si vas al mercado compra frijoles negros y el arroz que te gusta. No compres tanto pan.
Voy despues del trabajo. Tambien agarro pollo para dejar hecho.
Bueno. Y guarda un poquito para mi, pero sin tanta grasa como la otra vez.
Si, esta vez lo separo en envases pequenos antes de que me sirva doble.
Salsa after work? Raul says he might bring that tiny tin again for later lol
You making salsa tonight or did the phone headset win again?
Class yes. Tin no for me tonight, and I am good with one mojito max after.
I can do the 7:30 class, but after that I am going straight home. Calls stacked up all day.
Fine, responsible Donovan. Patio or inside at Ball & Chain?
Cool, quick cafecito after only if you got juice. Manny asked if we watching the Heat Saturday.
Inside if we can. Last time my shirt smelled like outside until laundry day.
Tell him maybe. Elena already has me looking at flyer colors tomorrow, so I am pacing myself.
You actually leaving work on time for downtown tonight or what?
Shoes are already in the car. If I miss warmup, save me a spot near the fan.
Claro. And cafecito after if your feet survive.
That part is half the reason I show up.
Salsa done and I am starving. La Carreta or just cafecito?
Cafecito only. I brought arroz con pollo for later and I am keeping March simple.
Fair. Also your black pair looked tired tonight, bro.
They get one more month. New soles can wait until the dental charge and phone glass are handled.
Mijo, tu tia mando un audio largo en el grupo. Dice que mejor esperar con lo de la primavera.
Mandamelo, pero no te preocupes por ese audio todavia. Vamos a ver lo que dice Dr. Ramos y la pagina de Jackson.
Traigo mi tarjetica el domingo?
Si, traela despues de misa. Si Ramos dice que toca, te llevo yo y despues compramos pan cubano.
Mijo, despues de mi cita en la clinica, puedes pasar por la panaderia de la 49? Necesito pan cubano y las pastillitas.
Si, Ma. I have to stop by the office downstairs first with that renewal folder, then I can grab everything.
Bueno. Tu edificio queda cerquita, gracias a Dios. No compres pastelitos para ti if you already ate.
Too late, if Vicky has guava ones I'm getting two. I'll bring yours before lunch.
Mijo, llego otra carta del seguro. No entiendo si tengo que pagar algo.
Take a photo and send it. I already moved the big apartment payment Tuesday, so I need to see the amount before I tell you what to do.
Ay no, no quiero que te aprietes por mi.
You're fifteen minutes away, Ma. Send the picture and I'll stop by Sunday after Mass if it needs a call.
Can you send me the festival flyer text tonight? Even rough is fine, I can paint around it.
Yes. I am stuck cleaning up a client deck first: English slides, Spanish handout, and a price table that keeps shifting.
Send me the flyer copy after that. Also do not let the price table eat your whole Saturday.
I made a yellow-pad list so I do not chase every version. Once the client sheet balances, I will export your flyer text.
Can you look at the Calle Ocho handout tonight? The booth arrows are still confusing and Maribel added two food tables.
Yeah, send the latest list. I can clean the arrows after dinner and make it print-friendly.
You still have that tidy grid brain from those old cafe pitch sheets. I trust you with the messy parts.
Funny how those old client layouts keep coming back. I’ll send you a PDF before 10.
Mijo, el papel de Humana dice algo de $86. No entiendo si es mío o de la visita nueva tuya.
Creo que es lo mío. Leave it on the table and I’ll read yours after Mass tomorrow.
No dejes eso para después si no has dormido bien. Anoche me llamaste como contando números en la cabeza.
I’m okay. I just need the rent payment to post and then I’ll decide. I can manage today.
Bro Thursday class, are you escaping by 6:30 or doing that office marathon again?
Trying. I'm already at 39.5 for the week and Monday's pipeline call ran long.
Ay no. Use one of those hours they give you and come dance before your knees quit.
I used a sick block in January, saving the vacation days for July. I'll text you after my 5:15 wrap-up.
Cafecito after class Thursday or you hiding with that laptop again?
Lol I can do one cortadito. I just need 20 min after work to move card stuff from the app into my sheet.
Bro you and those little boxes. Put $12 for me if I make you laugh.
Already left a food row open. Trying to keep March closer to 4 than that 4.3 mess.
Can you handle Mami's $63 insurance letter today or should I call them Monday?
Mami found another box from the W 49th apartment. Your badge from that first warehouse place is in there.
Did you actually use the cuff this morning or just stare at it on the counter?
I can do it. Yesterday's $4,900 line landed, and the $300 already moved out, so I'm keeping the rest boring.
The blue one? I was still catching the 54 bus before sunrise with Papi's coffee in my hand.
Used it. 134 over 84 first try, 128 over 82 after sitting still. I wrote both down.
Good. And keep the September papers in the folder, por favor. Last time you misplaced the page with the strip printout.
Good. Boring is fine. Just don't start adding five little things because the number looked better.
Yep. Also Abuela Teresa's receta notebook. I put it with my old report cards so it doesn't get tossed.
That's exactly why I let the app pull it first before I start saying yes to stuff.
Folder is in the car. The strip printout and the sheet that said go easy on late cafecitos are together.
Good. Save the yellow rent receipts too, Mami asked me about those.
I passed that bright wall by 8th again. The orange next to teal is basically your whole sketchbook.
Ha. I still have a photo of that wall next to an old record sleeve and a strip of auto paint chips.
Bring that combo Thursday. Also bring pastelitos if you stop near mom's place.
Deal. Palette board plus guava box.
Mijo, me llego otro mensaje del agua. Es de la ciudad o basura?
Es de Hialeah, Ma. I turned those notices on too. Forward it and I will check after Mass.
Bueno. Antes esas cosas se quedaban en la mesa y nadie las miraba.
I know. I am trying to stop doing that with the small ones.
Mijo, Marisol said you are studying otra vez tonight. No te quedes hasta tarde.
Solo one lesson after dinner. It is the online one about ads and follow-up lists.
You always liked talking to people more than boxes. Remember when you turned down that steady place by the loading dock?
I remember. That other desk had no guarantees, but it gave me room to build something.
Bro salsa Thursday. You coming or staying married to that laptop again? lol
Coming. I left myself the little black book on the counter so I don't start doing invoices at 10.
Good. Shoes, water, and no spreadsheet face.
Deal. I also need to finish Elena's flyer border before class, not rush it like a receipt.
Mami asked if you printed that county sheet again. She said the library line was too much last time.
I'll print hers and mine after lunch. I want to mark the mayor one after I read the Herald board notes.
Of course you made homework out of it. Just check where they stand on the clinic funding thing too.
Already have two campaign pages open. If the early place near Westland opens a Saturday slot, I'll take her.
Did you do the Sunday money check or are you still pretending the spreadsheet updates itself?
I did it. Kyoto tab says I need to keep the whole thing in the $3,500-$4,500 lane.
Then no random flight alerts on the card this month, Dono. Let that balance breathe.
Yeah. I marked only tea spots and two gardens for now, no buying anything.
Mijo, la carta del seguro dice que tengo que pagar $47. Es mucho?
Mandame foto, Mami. If it's just the copay I can cover it Friday, but I'm trying not to touch the cushion unless I have to.
No quiero que te aprietes por mi.
No te preocupes. I already moved the payday money aside, just need to keep the Honda draft and the Visa payment in mind.
Mami said you sounded wiped out. Long day?
Four stops. A bakery with 9 people, a dental office with 28, then two follow-ups. Half the questions were 'y eso se paga mensual o anual?'
Ay Dono. Eat something before you start rewriting every proposal tonight.
I just need to clean up the dental office one. Their dad signs checks but the daughter wants the portal screenshots.
I sent two flyer drafts. No rush tonight if your voice is fried from work.
Thank you. I am tapped out after the sales block. I can mark them up tomorrow before Luis starts texting cafecito temptations.
Tomorrow works. Also Manny's Heat commentary can wait; protect the quiet.
Exactly. Tonight is dinner, no talking, and the couch.
The speaker with the photo collage was intense tonight. I saw you taking notes when she talked about the complaint files disappearing into a drawer.
That part got me. If the file just vanishes, the family gets silence and the next person gets the same script.
You were quieter than usual when people started chanting.
I get why they were angry. I just wanted the board member to answer the actual questions on releases, retraining, and who signs off.
Mijo, the dentist office asks if your card changed. Same one from your job?
Mijo, anoche en la radio dijeron que ese plan nuevo promete demasiado. Tu abuelo siempre decia cuidado con los regalos grandes.
Same card, Ma. I renewed everything in the company portal last Tuesday.
Lo se, Ma. I read the details first. The clinic copay part looks practical, not like a speech in a plaza.
Bueno. And eat lunch today. You left the house so early.
Bueno. Pero mira quien paga y quien manda despues.
I packed it. Long day again, but I blocked 20 minutes between the 1:00 demo and the 1:45 follow-up.
Exactly. I can like the doctor visit help and still check the strings.
You coming salsa tonight or your arm still dramatic? lol
Arm is fine. I did the updated one at lunch because Baptist had open slots and my doctor said not to wait.
Responsible Donovan strikes again. Cafecito after?
Cafecito yes. Also remind me not to open the cousin chat before class, they are passing another unsourced screenshot.
You still coming salsa or you stuck watching that Hialeah video again? lol
Coming. Just finishing the part about parking on 49th. It started late and I skipped around.
Bro last year you would have deleted that email so fast.
Yeah, I missed enough of those little decision days. Leaving in 10.
You going straight home after salsa or hitting cafecito? I can swing by that place under the botanica.
Straight back. Inspector is coming early to look at the bedroom AC and I still have boxes blocking the hall.
Bro after all these years in that same spot, how do you still have boxes?
Receipts, old Heat stuff, paperwork. One closet loses the fight fast.
A few guys are meeting by the courthouse at 5. You coming or keeping it low-key?
Low-key. I can talk after, but standing in that crush after work is not happening for me.
You bringing lunch or hitting the truck with us?
Fair. Send me that link you said was actually balanced. My cousin is arguing with everybody in the group chat.
Brought mine. Rice, beans, chicken from the containers.
I'll send it. Also put $25 toward the local legal clinic this morning, so I'm not just scrolling.
Respect. I smelled it from here lol.
That's the problem. I made myself add salad before opening the second container.
You playing Saturday or still doing the old man machine before breakfast?
Playing. Machine showed 131/83 today, so I'm not being dramatic.
Cool. But no triple cafecito like September, bro. You scared everybody with that 9pm detour.
I know. The little printout was clean, lesson received.
For Mom’s insurance upload, use her name exactly like the Habana paper, not the clinic spelling.
Got it. Papá’s old one says Marianao, hers says Habana. The site hates accent marks.
Of course it does. Also don’t let Mom dictate the whole note in Spanish unless you have an hour.
Too late, she already started with “cuando llegamos” and I’m typing fast.
I can take Mami to the 2:30 appointment Monday, but can you do the online form tonight?
Yes. I have to wait until the $1,750 clears before I touch anything else, but the form is fine.
Do not put her copay on your card unless you actually have room.
I won't. Just send me the login and I'll deal with the paperwork first.
You disappeared after lunch. Manny asked if soccer is still on Saturday.
Probably skipping. I’ve been in the apartment with the blinds down since 2.
Ok, but don’t turn it into a whole weekend. Did the sales deck review go badly or are you stuck waiting on the quote again?
Both. And Mom’s lab portal still won’t load. I’ll come out tomorrow, just not tonight.
Did you decide on the car repair or are you still making columns like Papi used to do?
Columns first. I have the mechanic quote, the card interest, and next month's rent in one Sheet.
Good. Pick the one that does not mess up April. And stop checking work mail while you do it.
Too late. I had a client reply about the discount cap, so I added it to the account notes before closing the laptop.
Did you eat or are you doing that thing where the whole day is just checkmarks?
Ate arroz con pollo. I'm doing 20 minutes with the notebook, then leaving Mom's copay letter in your mailbox tomorrow.
Bueno. And don't rewrite the whole letter like it's court. Just highlight the weird parts.
Trying. The list can wait till morning.
I am at Cafe La Trova by the back wall. Bring the blue pencil if it survived your tiny apartment station.
It survived. I found it under the mousepad, which tells you everything about that corner.
Perfect. I want to catch the Calle Ocho pop-up after we finish these napkin studies.
Give me twenty. I am bringing the thin brush too in case your idea needs color.
Cafe sketch Sunday? I can bring the tiny watercolor kit.
Yes. I may show up with the little notebook too; it kept me from sending three messy emails today.
Good. Also no 6 pm espresso before sketching, please. Your lines get electric.
Deal. Tea tonight, then a quiet lap outside before I open the flyer file.
Little Havana opening tomorrow. I can bring the tiny peach squares from the art-walk bag if you want one.
Maybe half if everyone is just hanging after. I do not want any extras in my place.
Got it. Also, rooftop bar has those guava spritz things.
One of those is enough for me. I still want to sketch straight lines.
That blue piece at the exhibit stayed with you. You got so quiet after.
It felt like my grandmother's kitchen for a second. The color, the little hands, the song they had playing.
You should sketch that before it fades. Not polished, just honest.
Already did a rough one. I put the candle cup and her coffee spoon in the corner.
Mijo, domingo despues de misa vienes? No te quedes tarde otra vez con los papeles de la calle 8.
Voy, Ma. Tonight is just printing signs and fixing one logo for someone, nothing big.
Bueno. Trae pan cubano si puedes, y no regales todo tu sabado.
Bro we passed Westland on 49 after salsa and you got quiet. Too many memories?
Bro that clip from class had my left turn looking criminal 😂
That strip had everything. Paycheck cashing, bakery, bus stop, the pharmacy Mami liked.
I cropped myself out too, don't worry. The drums sounded too good not to post.
You said your sister used to save you pastelitos when your shift ran late?
You going to put the late game yelling right after the salsa video again?
Marisol and Abuela both. If Papi got there first, nothing survived.
Maybe. If Herro starts hitting ridiculous ones, the feed can survive one noisy clip.
Bro you coming to soccer Saturday or doing your county paper ritual again?
Soccer first. The ritual waits until coffee after. I need to finish the business-license questions on those pages.
You still got that folder from the big 2024 one?
Yeah, plus the 2022 notes. Makes it faster when the county opens early hours.
My cousin asked about the background form for that condo board thing. Yours was easy, right?
Heat game at mine tomorrow or you need quiet?
Pretty much. I only had to dig up dates for a couple of tickets and the Okeechobee Road crash report.
Quiet first half of the day, then I am good. This week had me pacing after calls, nothing wild.
You ever follow up with that person your sister found, or nah?
Nah. Primary doc gave me a worksheet and said to track sleep, coffee, and the tight-chest days for now.
That was the one where the guy with the clipboard kept everybody from yelling?
Yeah. He got us onto the shoulder, let me call my mom, and wrote everything clean for insurance.
Did Mami's CVS charge post twice or just pending?
Pending only. I checked the bank app before I typed it in the family tab.
Ok good. Don't let her letter pile make you redo everything.
I won't. The total is sitting at $1,820 right now, so March can still land around $3,900 if I don't get cute.
Can you FaceTime Mami before I go into the school thing? She keeps asking about the pharmacy paper.
Yeah, I'll call her at 6:15. Is Sofia done at dance by 7?
7:05. If you grab her, Daniel can stay for soccer. Also Mami wants the arroz con pollo the way Papi wrote it.
I have the card in my kitchen drawer. I'll do Sofia pickup and call Mami first.
Sending you the little lane behind the old wooden tea place. The shadows are ridiculous, you would draw there for hours.
That one went straight into the Kyoto folder. I added it after the moss garden page.
Good. Just do the pencil version for now before your Visa starts giving you side-eye again.
Exactly. Sketch first, deposits later.
Mijo, no te olvides del pan si pasas por la 12.
Voy despues de ver a los hermanos del taller. They want the cheaper monthly option but asked me to explain the setup fee to their mom too.
Entonces habla despacio, como con tu abuela. Y come algo.
Si. I printed both versions so nobody has to translate numbers at the counter.
Bro you skipping cafecito after class again?
Bro Brickell place after salsa Thursday? They got live band.
Maybe a quick one. I have to clean up the key-account worksheet before midnight.
Maybe cafecito only. I had to put $400 aside for the tire thing and I'm keeping the rest boring.
You and your worksheets lol. Same guy who said no to the safe clock-in spot at 26.
Dale, cafecito then. No fancy Miami tax this week lol.
That gamble is still paying tuition in tiny monthly payments.
Exactly. The app still shows $2,800 on the blue card, so I'm not adding dinner and drinks to it.
Field 2 today. You bringing the blue cleats?
Yeah, and the old shin guards. My legs still remember last Saturday.
Winter crew is short two people, so do not be late.
Walking over from parking now. Save me five minutes before you make me run.
Heat at my place tonight? I was gonna order wings.
I am in, but I will bring the frozen pastelitos from my freezer instead of adding to the order.
No problem. You still grabbing those records from Technique?
Leaving them there for now. Same with the black pair at DSW unless the heel finally gives out.
Voy a empezar el sofrito after my sugar check. If you come later, no compres mucho.
Just pan and maybe two pastelitos. I can put on the old son playlist from your tablet.
Bueno, but lower the volume when your sister calls. Last time Celia was louder than Marisol.
That was not my fault, your speaker is dramatic.
Sending the updated festival copy. Can you look at the corner text tonight only if it doesn't wreck your evening?
I'll give it one clean pass after dinner. Then notebook and phone down. I promised myself no midnight proving contest.
One clean pass is enough. Keep the lettering human, not sales brochure.
That's the line I needed. I'll make it look like people actually belong on the page.
The exhibit talk Friday is about farm crews, border paperwork, and who gets called disposable. You'd have thoughts.
Send it. Those are the things that keep pulling my pencil one way lately, even when the name beside the candidate doesn't do much for me.
Your pencil is allowed to move. Just don't let old fear choose everything for you.
Fair. I still hear family stories when someone promises a whole new world by Tuesday.
I saw you shared the public defender explainer. Thank you for picking something useful and not a rage screenshot.
I rewrote the caption three times. Wanted it clear without turning my comments into a mess.
Are you still skipping Saturday at Bayfront? No pressure, just checking before I make the little sign stack.
Yeah, skipping the wall-to-wall part. But send me the art file and I'll print a few for you Friday.
My aunt dropped a scary paragraph in our family chat. No link, just all caps and a praying hands sticker.
That sounds exactly like ours. I usually post the CDC or UM Health page once, then leave it alone.
Once is generous. Did your mom feel okay after her appointment?
Yeah, just tired. Her doctor said normal, so I told her soup, water, and no reading the chat tonight.
Tia Marta asked if you are bringing anyone to the birthday lunch Sunday.
Just me. If the table gets tight, put me next to the kids' end so I can help with plates.
Done. And don't say yes to three plans after lunch like last time.
I learned. Manny Friday, Luis Thursday, Elena's thing Saturday if I have enough left.
For the festival flyer, can we push final colors to Sunday? You sounded stretched yesterday.
Sunday works. When sales gets messy I start checking the same email ten times, but most weeks I can pull it back.
Do the cafe sketch hour first. No heroic all-night design sprint.
Deal. I am keeping it simple: walk, sketch, early dinner, no late screen loop.
The festival form asks how you want your name captioned under the poster credit. Same wording as last year?
Yes. Born here, raised on cafecito lectures, English homework after Spanish dinner-table crossfire.
That line is very you. Do you want the Miami part in the caption or just on the artist sheet?
Artist sheet only. Caption can stay with the two-last-name version and the family table line.
You still coming by before the Heat game or you doing family stuff?
Passing by Mom's first. She asked me to grab cascarilla and two red candles from the shop near Palm Ave.
Classic Lourdes. Bring pastelitos too if you stop anywhere decent.
If I make it before tipoff, I will. I have that old Irakere playlist for the drive, so I'll move fast.
Bro did you see that debate clip? Everybody just yelling over each other.
Yeah, I shut it off. Give me the budget line for the youth jobs program and the rule for when cameras get released.
Lol you and your spreadsheets. But yeah, slogans don't fix the block.
Exactly. Show the numbers, show who answers when someone crosses a line, and put money where kids actually go after school.
You still coming by for the 8pm one? I got the couch claimed before my cousins take it.
Yeah, leaving after I grab croquetas. Phone is already at 82 percent for once.
Good because last time your reaction to Spo's timeout was better than the actual play.
Do not remind me. If it happens again I'm posting the croquetas first so the night has balance.
You sounded fast on the phone. Did you eat or just do cafecito rounds?
Ate late. Also too much coffee. Putting the mug away after this one.
Bueno. Take the outside loop before you answer more people.
Back. No headphones helped. Writing the two calls down instead of replaying them.
Cafecito after class Thursday or you acting like a responsible adult again?
Maybe cafecito, not dinner. This one came in around $4,200 and the $250 pull already hit.
Bro one cafecito is not a financial crime lol. I got the pastelito if you show up on time.
Deal. I just need the buckets to settle before I start pretending Thursday is a holiday.
Bro after salsa we grabbing something or you doing your responsible fridge thing again?
Fridge thing. I still have ropa vieja and beans waiting.
That sounds better than anything open right now.
Exactly why I can't eat it straight from the pot. Plate, lid back on, walk away.
Cookout at my cousin's after soccer. You riding with me?
Yeah. I am bringing Topo Chico and maybe I will have one Corona with food.
Back table or driveway crew?
Back table. Driveway crew always leaves my hoodie smelling rough.
You watching the Heat or doing that quiet Japan notebook thing again?
Both. Halftime is for comparing April airfare and the garden pass notes.
Bro, compare only. Last time the hotel hold stayed on your card forever.
I remember. Tonight is just notes and maybe one sketch thumbnail.
Mami found an envelope with old car papers. Speeding thing from 2018, expired sticker notice, and the Okeechobee Road report. Keep?
Keep the report and toss the duplicate sticker notice. The 2018 one I paid online already.
The report has a note that you called Lourdes from the shoulder. Ay, she still talks about that.
I remember. The scene was messy, but the guy taking statements slowed everybody down.
Estas despierto? Marisol dijo que los nenes quieren pastelitos despues de misa.
Up. I'll stop at Vicky Bakery and be there by 10:20.
Trae tambien las flores pequenas para Rafael, las blancas si tienen.
Got it. I'll call you from the bakery if the line is crazy.
Mami wants to know if you are bringing croquetas after Mass.
Not this Sunday. I have bread and eggs here, so I will cook before I go.
Okay. Did the flyer thing pay you yet?
Elena said tomorrow. That covers the screen place, and the shoe box stays on the shelf a little longer.
Your flyer draft has that glossy car-shop red in the background. Intentional?
Yeah, I matched it from a paint chart I kept. Then I traced the lettering from that Celia jacket for the border rhythm.
It works. The border feels like music without drawing instruments.
Good. I will drop it off after I pick up bread for Ma.
Heat at my place tonight? Low pressure. You can sit there and yell at turnovers.
Not tonight, bro. I’m still in work clothes and haven’t answered anyone since morning.
That sounds like the quiet cave thing. Is it the demo tomorrow or Lourdes stuff?
Demo, rent math, and her new pharmacy form. I keep opening the calendar hold and closing it like that solves anything.
Mijo, antes del cafe, sentado tranquilo. Como te dijeron.
Ya. 129/81 today. I took the photo for Dr. Benitez.
Bueno. Y no me hagas otro susto como septiembre despues de tanto trabajo y cafe tarde.
